# hallpass_approver_rule (Resource)

Says which operators may approve which requests (in the console, Slack or Telegram). Operators also need the approver or administrator role. Import with the rule ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hallpass_operator" "ada" {
  email = "ada@example.com"
}

resource "hallpass_approver_rule" "web" {
  name      = "Ada approves web changes"
  operators = { operators = [data.hallpass_operator.ada.id] }
  targets   = { server_groups = ["prod-web"] }
  roles     = { all = true }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `operators` (Attributes) Which operators may approve. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operators))
- `roles` (Attributes) Which roles and access profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `targets` (Attributes) Requests for which servers and git remotes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, shown to operators.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule applies.
- `max_duration` (String) Longest access these operators may approve. A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule ID (`apr_…`).

<a id="nestedatt--operators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operators`

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) Match every operator, including ones created later.
- `operator_groups` (Set of String) Operator group names (for example from single sign-on group mappings).
- `operators` (Set of String) Operator IDs (`opr_…`); see the `hallpass_operator` data source.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) Match every role, including ones created later.
- `ids` (Set of String) Role IDs (`rol_…`).
- `names` (Set of String) Role or access profile names (on any matching server).
- `role_labels` (Attributes) Roles by label. Every `match_labels` pair and every expression must hold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles--role_labels))

<a id="nestedatt--roles--role_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles.role_labels`

Optional:

- `match_expressions` (Attributes List) Label expressions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles--role_labels--match_expressions))
- `match_labels` (Map of String) Labels that must have exactly these values.

<a id="nestedatt--roles--role_labels--match_expressions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles.role_labels.match_expressions`

Required:

- `key` (String) Label key.
- `operator` (String) `In`, `NotIn`, `Exists` or `DoesNotExist`.

Optional:

- `values` (Set of String) Values for `In` and `NotIn`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Rule ID
terraform import hallpass_approver_rule.web apr_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
